Eggman is on the loose and everyone is searching for him. While Mr. Stewart investigates Eggman's whereabouts, he is captured along with Chris in Eggman's secret hideout in the sewers.

The President hosts a tournament with the red Chaos Emerald as the prize to lure Dr. Eggman. It's a heated battle that finds Sonic fighting alongside everyone, even the President himself, but strangely Dr. Eggman has yet to show himself…

The battle for the red Chaos Emerald is heating up. As contestants duke it out for the glory and the prize it's Emerl who wins the tournament. But when Emerl receives the emerald, its power forces him to go on a rampage and attack everyone in the stadium.

Fujiko Mine, a mysterious woman who claims to be Fujiko's aunt, gives Lupin an ultimatum: Find Marshal Rommel's lost gold or die! First, Lupin must decipher the location of the gold, written in ancient hieroglyphs. Will Lupin be able to locate the golden treasure? Time is running out!

The great thief Rat Boy Jirokichi IV appears before Goemon and reveals that their ancestors competed in the first International Thieves Championship together, but were defeated by Lupin's grandfather, Arsène Lupin. Jirokichi proposes the two should team up to avenge their ancestors' dishonour, but will the Lupin clan claim the win again?

It's finally the day of the Saint Ishiyama School Festival and the big volleyball match! But the match doesn't happen until the afternoon, so Furuichi decides to enjoy the school festival atmosphere, specifically the Maid Cafe that Azusa and her class are running. Unfortunately things get a bit out of hand...

Lister is presented with a disappointing vision of his future, but Rimmer is delighted.
Rimmer encounters his most dangerous challenge ever - Lister is taking the chef's exam.
Lister's rather mundane day perks up a little when he discovers he is a God.
Lister contracts a mutated virus and his hallucinations materialise in solid form.
Rimmer creates his perfect companion - an identical duplicate of himself.
The crew answer a cry for help from three damsels and an android in distress.
The boys become immersed in the Better than Life reality game.
Lister and Cat wake up with their legs in plaster. What's going on?
The crew of Red Dwarf have found a way to go back in time three million years.
Holly has been deposed and the back-up computer Queeg 500 is in control of Red Dwarf.
Holly's latest invention takes the crew into a bizarre parallel universe.
Time starts to run backwards after the boys travel through a time hole.
Red Dwarf is on a collision course towards a minefield of black holes.
A chameleonic genetic mutant which sucks out human emotions is loose aboard Red Dwarf.
Lister accidentally triggers the ship's self-destruct system.
The crew run amok through history, blithely ignoring the consequences of causality.
Kryten has 24 hours to live, so the crew decide to give him the best night of his life.
Kryten falls in love with a female droid rescued from a crashed vessel.
Lister's curry finds its way into the transmogrifier and assumes near-human form.
Justice World is able to inflict crime back on the perpetrator. Rimmer is in big trouble.
Holly, for reasons best known to herself, decides to power down the ship.
In a universe almost identical to our own, another more heroic Arnold Rimmer exists.
A matter transporter whisks the crew to Waxworld - a giant theme park.
Rimmer is transmitted from Red Dwarf to the advanced Holoship, Enlightenment.
The Inquisitor roams through time weeding out life's wastrels and deleting the worthless.
Rimmer is taken prisoner inside his own mind and ends up being stripped and humiliated.
After an encounter at a viral research centre, Rimmer puts the crew in quarantine.
The boys from the Dwarf meet their evil doppelgangers, hell bent on destruction.
The crew discover an abandoned space ship, complete with a gigantic sea monster.
In pursuit of the stolen Red Dwarf, Lister and Co are attacked by scantily-clad Psirens.
A malfunctioning guidance beam drags the Dwarfers to a deserted space station.
Kryten contracts a deadly computer virus, and the crew are forced to enter his mindscape.
Lister gets a horrifying proposal from the chief of the offensively ugly GELF tribe.
Trapped aboard a disintegrating ship, Rimmer abandons his crewmates.
The crew are alarmed to receive an SOS call from themselves fifteen years into the future.
Lister's search for an Indian takeaway brings him to Dallas, 1963.
Rimmer's alter ego, Ace, arrives on Starbug fatally wounded with one dying request.
The Dwarfers encounter a real, live human woman who's attractive and nice.
The crew go on a journey of personal discovery when their generators fail.
Lister is missing Rimmer, at least until Kryten steps in to help.
In a hope to educate the crew Kochansky transports them to Pride and Prejudice World.
Lister is impregnated with a virus and he tries to talk his way out of the problem.
The crew finally discover who stole Red Dwarf and why.
The nanobots have not only re-created Red Dwarf, they have also brought back the old crew.
Rimmer plans to move up the career ladder with help from a 'sexual magnetism virus'.
The Dwarfers face two years in the brig for crimes against the Space Corps.
Lister joins a battle-hardened convict army, trained to go on suicide missions.
Kryten, who has been reprogrammed, starts his own pay TV station for the prisoners.
Lister and Rimmer are forced to take on the guards in a basketball game.
Pete the Sparrow is devolved into a Tyrannosaurus Rex by a time-wand.
The Dwarfers are now on probation and are trying their hardest to behave.
Nine years on and the Red Dwarf crew are older but still none the wiser.
Rimmer's replacement, Katerina, is determined to guide Lister back to his home planet.
Knowing they are destined to die, the Dwarfers head to a mysterious address to plead for life.
Rimmer receives an SOS Distress Call from his all-conquering brother, Howard.
On Father's Day, Rimmer points out Lister has been a lousy father to himself.
Marooned in Britain in 23 AD, the Dwarfers need an 8 volt battery to get home.
Lister loses Rimmer in a game of poker to a group of Biologically Engineered Life Forms.
Lister gets himself in a love triangle with Snack Dispensers 23 and 34.
Certain death at the hands of the simulants lead the Dwarfers to wonder if it's the end.
The Dwarfers find themselves in an alternative reality where technology is prohibited.
Lister and Cat get trapped when investigating a shipwreck at the bottom of an ocean moon.
After an altercation with a deranged droid, Lister has his kidneys organ-napped.
After a scandalous piece of good fortune, Rimmer is promoted to being an Officer.
Kryten has a mid-life crisis and changes his body cover from grey to Ferrari red.
Cat takes time off from being in love with himself to fall for a lady Cat.
The crew stumble on a science centre where vile historical figures have been 'cured' of evil.
Lister, Cat and Rimmer are uploaded into mechanoid bodies and forced into slavery.
The Dwarfers run into a ship where criticism is illegal.
When the machines on Red Dwarf go on strike, a presidential election is held.
The Dwarfers discover that the owners of Red Dwarf have been bought out.

Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.
The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.
After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his w

The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part o

The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'

Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing ch

The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should

The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into dead

Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a chi

It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demol

Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tel

Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his f

The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally con

The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. Eisenhower addresses troops in Southern England; the 'Big Show' begins; airborne troops dropped behind enemy lines; support aircraft drop everything from howitzers to motorcycles; bombers blast bridges and supply lines; sea forces bombard enemy fortifications on French coast; British and second army swarm over coast at Omaha and Utah Beaches; German west wall broken.

The Greatest coordination of arms ever portrayed in the world. Every scene made during the greatest victory of Allied power, to date. 11,000 Allied planes plant their tons of pulverizing bombs on shore installations, strategic roads and bridges, then swoop down to strafe enemy trains, ships and planes. French civilians and U.S. Army engineers repair and salvage railroad yards, bridges, and trains.

Germany is retreating on all fronts and suffering defeat after defeat. The breach of Germany's pre-War borders now seems inevitable. Desperate, Hitler orders all males between the ages of 16 and 70 to enlist and fight for the fatherland. Nazi ideologues put faith in victory and the Nazis seem to vanquish and suppress all forms of doubt and resistance in the last months of the Reich.

With recolorized archives, this episode explores the final year of Hitler's infamous division. From recruitment and indoctrination to their last missions, we uncover who these men were-and how they became perpetrators of mass murder. Following their brutal combat and crimes against humanity, we confront the chaos, ideology, and horror that defined the Das Reich's final descent.

programmes.t: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programmes.d: In mid-August 1944, the Allies launched 'Operation Anvil' to increase pressure on German troops after the Normandy landings. The 517th Airborne was tasked with preventing enemy tanks from reaching the beachhead. This episode recounts the story of three American sergeants and a British major who jumped into enemy territory, successfully completed their mission, and survived to tell the tale.

programmes.t: The Amazing World of War Machines
programmes.d: Beneath the waves lurks a stealthy war machine. Capable of carrying nuclear weapons, submarines play a key role in the defense of many countries around the world today. The earliest beginnings of submarines can be traced back to the time of Alexander the Great in 323 B.C. In 1776 American inventor David Bushnell designed and constructed the first military submarine.

programmes.t: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programmes.d: Christophe Rocancourt is a French impostor and con artist who scammed rich and powerful people by masquerading in turn as a French nobleman, the heir to the Rockefeller family, or as a Russian prince.

programmes.t: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programmes.d: Matthew Cox is a former mortgage broker from Florida who found himself on the Secret Service's most wanted list; he made millions falsifying homeownership and mortgage documents for five times the properties' actual worth.

programmes.t: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programmes.d: Jan Lewan is the polka sensation from Pennsylvania who fleeced millions of investors with his classic Ponzi scheme; his name shot to fame when Netflix produced the movie "Polka King" with actor Jack Black playing Jan Lewan.

programmes.t: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programmes.d: Nicknamed The Chameleon, Frédéric Bourdin is a former French serial imposter who claims to have faked at least five hundred false identities, including a young Texas boy who went missing in the mid-90s.

programmes.t: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programmes.d: Shaun Greenhalgh is a British artist and art forger; between 1989 and 2006, he produced a number of forgeries including Roman and Chinese art objects, and medieval Christian relics, that fooled some of the world's most respected art institutions.

programmes.t: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programmes.d: Dubbed the "Mini Madoff," Kiener is one of Germany's greatest con artists, tricking thousands of private investors and banks, including Barclays and J.P. Morgan, to the tune of more than $300 million.

Basada en hechos reales. Cinco familias siempre han controlado la isla; cinco familias comparten la fortuna de la Isla y cinco familias comparten su maldición.

The sands of the Moroccan Desert rhythmically dance across a vast, ethereal landscape. This immense region of parched sand and rock appears frozen for eternity, but it is not, as the dunes of the desert are ever being carefully shaped and transformed by the capricious winds of time.

Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hooterville�and she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

It's a very official third season premiere for Green Acres when the retirement of a state senator leaves Hooterville considering its best candidate for the job. Of course, they turn to their beloved lawyer-come-farmer Oliver Douglas (Eddie Albert).

Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fianc� stood him up at the alter on their big day.

Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing� on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.
José Desman kills his employer, former judge Salazar, who had sentenced his father. This story explores revenge and personal justice as the son confronts the man responsible for his family’s tragedy.

programmes.t: May God Forgive You... But I Won't
programmes.d: While Cjamango is away from his ranch six bandits attack and kill all the members of his family.

programmes.t: You're Jinxed, Friend You've Met Sacramento
programmes.d: This fast-moving tale revolves around the kidnaping of a boxer's daughter. The boxer pays the ransom money but the girl is still not released. Her boyfriend decides to get her back his own way, killing her ruthless captor in a fierce duel.

The eldest daughter of a pioneer family is kidnapped by a mysterious Indian tribe and the eldest son pursues. In order to win back his sister's freedom, he must sacrifice his own life by passing the test of "Crooked Sky" and shield his sister from an executioner's arrow. Along the way, he recruits a broken down, drunk prospector to help him track down the unknown tribe and rescue his sister.

After witnessing his parents’ murder by a ruthless gang, a young man dedicates his life to becoming the fastest gun in the West. Years later, he returns to his hometown, armed with deadly skill and a thirst for vengeance, determined to face the killers who destroyed his family and reclaim his peace.

In 1867 Texas, after the Civil War, Colonel Thomas Blake and his men refuse to surrender, raiding Yankee towns. Rumors swirl that Blake kills for pleasure, not the Confederacy, leading to large bounties for his capture. However, Blake seeks $200,000 that vanished during the war from Confederate coffers. He sends Chamaco Gonzales to track down the missing fortune, hidden in General Beauregard's strong box.
A Swedish arms dealer and a Mexican peon team up to rescue the intellectual leader of the Revolutionary cause, while taking part in numerous misadventures along the way.

During the Civil War, three outlaws face execution for selling guns to the enemy — until a Confederate general spares them. Their mission: recover a hidden fortune in gold under the watch of an officer. But rival treasure hunters turn their path to freedom into a deadly race.

When bandits begin kidnapping Clayton City’s elite for ransom, Sartana is called in to restore order. But the gang’s mysterious leader sees him as a deadly threat and hires four expert killers to take him down. To save the town and expose the mastermind, Sartana must survive every trap and betrayal.

A poor Mexican farmer, evicted from his land, turns to banditry and ends up in prison. While he serves his sentence, his young son is adopted by a wealthy family. Once freed, he sets out to reclaim both his child and the $200,000 he hid after a bank robbery, facing a struggle between love and greed.

After waking up with amnesia in the desert next to a dead man, Luke Barrett begins piecing together his past. A stranger in black reveals that Luke was hired to kill his own brother, Victor Barrett, a wealthy landowner. As Luke seeks the truth, a deadly confrontation looms, and his memory recovery brings both clarity and danger.

Ranch owner MacGregor has seven sons and oldest Gregor leads his brothers to Las Mesas, a small town where they want to sell horses. They get into trouble with local people who are related with evil Santillana. After getting imprisoned and losing their horses they decide to go after Santillana's gang.

Chicago drill artist King Von is shot to death in a fight he started outside an Atlanta night club. The altercation is caught on surveillance cameras...but what was the nature of the beef that led to his death? And why did Von throw the first punch?

Was the murder of beloved New Orleans Rapper, Magnolia Shorty, whose voice was sampled on Drake’s 2018 smash hit “In My Feelings”, a crime of passion? Or a gang-related hit? Did the choices she made in her private life put her into the line of fire?

Rapper and French Montana protege, Chinx, was the victim of a drive-by shooting in Queens, NY in 2015. Was his murder the bloody end of a feud born in prison? And once he was back on the streets, was Chinx actually being 'hunted' by his killer?

Van delves into the unsolved mystery of the murder of New Orleans legend and “No Limit” rap star, Soulja Slim. Nearly two decades later, questions remain: was his murder the result of a life lived in the streets? Or was it something more sinister?

Young rap star XXXtentacion’s life was cut tragically short when he was shot dead in the parking lot of a motorsports store near his home in Florida. Was this more than just a robbery gone wrong? And did XXXtentacion predict his own murder?
Was up and coming Dallas rapper Mo3’s murder a crime of passion? Or a case of clout-chasing taken to the deadliest extreme? Van Lathan investigates the brazen highway shooting of Dallas rapper Mo3.

FBG Duck helped define the signature sound of Chicago Drill Music only to be gunned down in a mob style hit on the city’s streets. Was he murdered because of his street ties? His disrespectful music? Or was he just from the wrong block in Chicago?

For years, questions have surrounded Eazy-E's untimely death. Now his daughter Ebie is looking for answers. She will interview witnesses, uncover new evidence and explore every theory. Starting with the question: Did he even have AIDS to begin with?

Eazy-E's daughter Ebie and her mother Tracy Jernagin continue to examine his death by taking a closer look at Eazy's notorious rivalry with Suge Knight. They also explore the theory that he may have been injected with HIV.

Eazy-E's never-before-heard final interview is uncovered and offers clues about his mysterious death. Ebie investigates Eazy's manager. Ebie, Tracy and Jasmine take a closer look at Eazy's last weeks and make surprising discoveries.

As the investigation nears its end, surprising new information sheds light on Eazy-E's final days in the hospital. Witnesses to his last days who have never spoken publicly finally reveal what they saw.

Angela opens up about her devastating breakup and the pressures of living in the spotlight. Vanessa throws a party to reunite the heirs and clear the air while Romeo gets caught up in a love triangle. Boogie's addiction takes a turn for the worst.

Tee Tee and Briana beef over Romeo's affections. Dame enlists Master P to scare Boogie straight. Angela moves to LA for a fresh start. Romeo hopes to get close to his newly-single former flame. Red flags are raised about naive Egypt's relationship.

Game night at Pepa's house spirals into fight night! Dame and Pep clash over the severity of Boogie's addiction while Briana enters to confront a nasty rumor. Angela and Romeo reunite for the first time since Angela's breakup.

Angela and Romeo's Orlando getaway leads to a hotel nightcap. Briana and Pepa clash at a releasing ceremony when Pepa brings alcoholic spirits. Boogie is blindsided when he is lead to a surprise drug intervention.

Boogie's intervention spirals out of control when Kristinia and Briana nearly come to blows! Romeo and Angela discuss their relationship. Angela drops a bomb on her and Vanessa's business plan. On the brink of destruction, Boogie checks into rehab.

Pepa's son Tyran comes to town with old baggage in tow. Tyran interrogates Egypt's boyfriend Sam. Drama ensues at a welcome party for Tyran. Master P is blindsided when he discovers that his incarcerated brother has gone on a hunger strike!

The danger surrounding Master P's incarcerated brother comes to a head. Tee Tee plays cupid for Briana to make amends, but her grand plan backfires! Tyran struggles to get Pepa's attention. After a blowup, Angela and Vanessa must unite for charity.

Boogie is released from rehab and temptation strikes! Master P mentors the guys on a camping trip. Family therapy with Pepa and her son, Tyran, bursts into flames. Kristinia meets her cousin Kyndall, El DeBarge's daughter, for the first time ever.

Angela and her siblings talk about marriage while Tee Tee goes on a first date with Romeo. Tee Tee's hair event sparks trouble when Kristinia's cousin, Kyndall, and her enemy, Briana, face off. Since their fight night blowup, Pepa and Dame reunite!

Marriage is on the radar! JoJo is pressed to make a proposal. Meanwhile, Romeo's torn between Angela and Tee Tee. Egypt's bikini shoot turns left when her boyfriend, Sam tries to take over. Drama ignites when momager, Pepa, checks Egypt!

Kristinia moves to Sin City and throws a welcome party! The rivalry between Briana and Kristinia comes to a head. Tee Tee is blindsided when Romeo reveals that he has a secret crush on another woman! Panic strikes when Egypt and Sam run off to elope!

Angela is shell-shocked when she suffers a major loss. Romeo runs to Angela's side. Boogie betrays his family to avoid his father, Dame. A family dispute between the Pepas comes to a head at Romeo's yacht party. A table is flipped and fists fly!

Angela is blindsided when Vanessa takes business matters into her own hands. Pepa's security guard turned boyfriend violates his new father figure role. A disgruntled Briana comes for Tee Tee. In a long-awaited reunion, Dame unleashes on Boogie!

Boogie and Dame have a life-altering meet up. Sparks fly between Romeo and Angela. Angela avoids Vanessa at the racetrack and pushes Vanessa to her breaking point. A shocking scandal rocks Pepa's world when Aundre's past comes back to haunt him.

Lil Twist brings trouble to Dame's Culture Vulture Event which threatens Sam. Meanwhile, Twist has eyes for Egypt. Romeo stands up to Master P and suffers the blowback. A scandal from Aundre's past emerges and jeopardizes Pepa's million-dollar deal.

Romeo and Bow Wow face off in an epic battle of the Lil's! Pepa's conflicted between her career and her relationship. On a romantic stroll in New Orleans, Angela and Romeo take shocking next steps to move forward in their relationship.

Angela and Romeo's double date backfires! Pepa's relationship with Aundre takes a turn for the worst. Tee Tee throws a singles party where an uninvited guest pops up with a vengeance. Sam and Lil Twist nearly come to blows over Egypt.

Romeo finds himself in troubled waters with Angela when he drops out of their double date. Dame confronts his nemesis. Pepa struggles with a broken heart. Master P warns Eric about digging up Eazy-E's death. Vanessa's birthday surprise.

Angela opens up about her past at a Fearless Conference. Dame and Rocky struggle to conceive. Vanessa exposes a shocking secret. Suspicions around Eazy-E's death deepen. Briana blows up and storms off when feelings about her father are triggered.

Angela is set up on a hot date with someone other than Romeo. Meanwhile, JoJo prepares a surprise of a lifetime. Drama ignites at Lil Twist's listening party when Briana spirals down a dangerous path and everyone is shook.

Vanessa confronts Romeo about his feelings for Angela. Briana's birthday goes up in flames when Briana and Eric nearly come to blows. JoJo surprises his sisters when he takes them shopping for an engagement ring.

After a blind date disaster, Angela is blindsided when Romeo surprises her in New York. JoJo panics to pull off a marriage proposal. In the aftermath of an explosive birthday brawl, Briana's invite to Boogie's important showcase has everyone on edge.
Just when Angela and Romeo take a chance at love, Angela's world falls apart when tragedy strikes and shocks all. Dame checks on a troubled Briana who makes a brutal decision no one saw coming.
Romeo drops a bombshell on the Simmons family that rocks Angela to her core! Meanwhile, Egypt's boyfriend Sam does sneaky business at a pawn shop. Panic strikes when a secret engagement is exposed.

Angela and Romeo's rivalry comes to a head and sends shockwaves through Romeo's party. Vanessa's stuck in the middle and JoJo flies off the handle! Meanwhile, a scandal strikes Salt-N-Pepa. Angela is blindsided when Briana does the unexpected.

Romeo blocks everyone on social media and causes uproar, but Angela has receipts! Tee Tee and Tyran join forces to derail Sam and Egypt's trip to the altar, and warn Pepa and Treach before it's too late. Angela plans to squash the beef with Briana.

JoJo seeks marriage guidance from Rev Run when JoJo's baby fever strikes a bad chord with Tanice. Pepa warns Tee Tee to stop meddling in Egypt and Sam's relationship while Briana rages on. Ava breaks down over the legal war with her father Dame.

Angela and Briana's long-lasting feud comes to a head. A secret marriage shocks all. While Romeo is out of the country, Boogie shoots his shot with Angela. Rumor spreads that Tee Tee is in love with Sam and Lil Twist puts it on full blast!

With Romeo on ice, things fire up between Angela and Boogie. Tee Tee runs into some old foes. Sam is served a fair warning before he seeks Pepa and Treach's blessing to marry Egypt. Boogie opens up a rehab facility but Dame smells a scam.

programmes.t: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes

programmes.t: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes

programmes.t: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes
programmes.d: Pressure mounts against the school board to take accountability; Dr. Kenney leaves North Port for what seems like the final time; the community grapples with guilt and grief; Stephen offers an intimate look into Kenney's hypnosis practice.

La carrera para preparar el campamento en Wolverine se convierte en una pesadilla.
El brutal viaje a una nueva mina separa a la familia y lleva a Josh al límite.
Los pequeños lujos en el campamento animan a un equipo descontento y los visitantes sorpresa aumentan las esperanzas de Claudia.
Gary y Josh no regresan de una búsqueda rutinaria de combustible y los núcleos de perforación ponen en duda la calidad de las lentes de jade en 2 Mile.
La tripulación finalmente logra un gran éxito, pero con el invierno acercándose, a Claudia le preocupa que el gran hallazgo haya llegado demasiado tarde.

Tensions boil over between Robin, Josh and Steve about how to mine and when Claudia steps in, things get downright explosive.
Plagados de problemas con los camiones, Robin y su equipo corren para hacer un suministro de combustible antes de que el equipo se agote.
Robin choca con Claudia y Josh por la calidad del jade que sale de su pozo, mientras que el intento de Larry de ayudar a llevar el barracón de la tripulación al campamento fracasa.
Claudia y su equipo están decididos a seguir minando a pesar de los incendios forestales que arden alrededor de su reclamo, hasta que las cosas empeoran y tienen que correr para salir.
Claudia se estresa tratando de preparar su mejor jade para los compradores, mientras la moral de su equipo se pone a prueba mientras luchan contra el frío.
Claudia hace todo lo posible para intentar hacer una gran venta a los compradores de jade, mientras en la mina Guy y Gary luchan contra la primera tormenta de nieve de la temporada.
Claudia presiona a su equipo para que siga minando a pesar de las gélidas temperaturas y el deterioro de las condiciones de las carreteras.
Después de años de obtener la parte dura del trato con Scrappy Larry, Robin le hace una broma a su viejo amigo.
Bajo presión para cumplir con el ajustado plazo de su comprador, Robin y Josh chocan cuando se topan con interminables problemas.
Cuando una avería grave amenaza con cerrar la mina, Claudia y Robin toman la arriesgada decisión.
Josh evita por poco el desastre al entrar a la mina con una carga de combustible y Claudia queda devastada.
Claudia recurre a su padre Steve en busca de ayuda cuando teme que la mayor venta de su carrera minera se le esté escapando de las manos.
La tensión surge entre Claudia, Robin y Josh mientras hacen un último intento por cerrar un trato con un comprador de Vietnam.
Mover una enorme losa de jade pone a prueba el antiguo equipo de la mina y la paciencia de Josh.
Robin descubre una enorme lente de jade en Two Mile, pero podría ser demasiado grande para que su pequeña operación la excave.
Cuando una extraña tormenta de nieve en agosto deja a Claudia y Robin varados en Two Mile, Gary y Garon intentan salvar el día conduciendo a través de la tormenta.
Robin toma una decisión difícil sobre su querido camión minero 6-Pack después de otra costosa avería.
La nueva temporada minera está llena de sorpresas desagradables, pero un rescate improbable salva el día.
Harto de trabajar para su padre, Josh inicia su propio negocio de transporte por carretera con un semirremolque nuevo.
El camión del ejército muere en el brutal camino hacia la mina.
Gary y su hijo rescatan un viejo camión del ejército, pero conducirlo hasta la mina es brutal.
Justin llega volando con una sierra de alambre nueva, pero pierde la calma al intentar configurarla.
El equipo encuentra innumerables problemas al tratar de cortar un trozo de la lente de 60 pies.
Claudia trae un gran equipo de perforación y tiene sólo cuatro días para encontrar el mejor jade, pero ella y Robin no pueden decidir dónde buscar.

It's 1999 and a drug-addicted nurse, her scheming cousin and a group of black market organ-trading criminals get caught up in a heist gone wrong. Starring Angela Bettis (“Dexter,” Carrie).
C-list celebrities compete in a reality show but after a few days one of the contestants is brutally murdered.
Shirin moves into a new home with her partner, and his son Lucas. Shirin realizes that they are haunted by an evil that wants Lucas at any cost.

A nun’s disturbing behavior sparks rumors of demonic possession at a remote convent. Benjamin, a priest-in-waiting, and his disillusioned mentor, Father Donaghue, are sent to investigate, their methods backfire, leaving a wake of terror and trauma.
A cathartic girls trip to the desert turns deadly when demon-worshipping incels discover their secluded house and decide to make these girls their sacrifice.
A pair of college dropouts must travel across time in order to save Earth from an otherworldly invasion.
Tucker and Dale, two best friends on vacation at their dilapidated mountain house, are mistaken for murderous backwoods hillbillies by a group of obnoxious, preppy college kids.

A creature plunges from a bridge into the Han River, emerging on its shores for a feeding frenzy upon onlookers. When a young girl is snatched in the melee, her family sets off to recover her from the monster.
Chris arrives at the “party,” and discovers he’s fallen prey to a lethal trap set. He must survive the night.
A team-building weekend in the mountains of Eastern Europe goes horribly wrong for the sales division.
A snobby musical theater camp is terrorized by a blood-thirsty killer who hates musical theater.
A musician couple captures a sound not meant for human ears. Soon, a stranger knocks on their door and their reality begins to blur.

Based on a true story comes this chilling tale where the ghost of Caravaggio comes to life and murders Nuns in the Italian hillside. As murders based on the paintings come true, one police inspector and a young Nun discover a secret.
A newlywed couple's idyllic country-lake honeymoon descends into chaos.

An ancient Chippewa demon, the WINDIGO, is resurrected by a Native American teenager and his grandmother to protect their family. However, the creature's lust for killing cannot be controlled and each killing bonds the teen and the Windigo closer.
On the eve that the crew of the very first manned expedition to Mars is about to return to Earth, it makes an astounding discovery - fossilized evidence of life on Mars.
4 friends seek dark adventure and end up in a demonic time loop.

Mary is living out of her car and can barely take care of herself. She breaks into an unoccupied mansion hoping for peace and solitude. But she is not alone and must decide whether her previous life is better than the new alternative.
As four students enter a corn-maze, the creatures inside are a deranged family of human skin harvesters.
A family business expands beyond their wildest dreams; however, their dreams are the nightmares of others!

Alice (Emily Beecham) has engineered a special flower that makes its owner happy. Against company policy, Alice takes one home to her son. As their plant grows, so does Alice's suspicion that her new creation may not be as harmless as they thought.
An unemployed man who spends his days hiding from his nagging wife in his allotment shed faces a difficult decision when a zombie apocalypse strikes his neighborhood.
In an apocalyptic wasteland Pike leads a group of survivors through the new America.
Tom Hiddleston stars as Dr. Robert Laing, the newest resident of a luxurious apartment in a high-tech skyscraper whose lofty location places him amongst society's upper class.

In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian "Armored Bandit," who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

Set against the 1912 Mexican Revolution, Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) leads a small band of misfits into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons, stolen by bloodthirsty revolutionaries and their infamous leader Hector Cordoba (Raf Vallone).
Audie Murphy plays a troubled saddle tramp with a penchant for drinking. After inheriting a ranch, he is led back into the arms of an old flame.

When an outlaw is shot during a heist and left for dead by his partners - who take his money and his woman - he sets out to track them down. And when he catches up with them, he'll have to rely on his wits...as much as the loaded gun in his holster!

In this compelling and imaginative western, a peace-loving Swedish seaman is forced to take on an entire frontier town when he discovers a ruthless oil prospector has been forcing farmers to sell their land...or pay for it with their lives.

In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

In this comedy western, Lee Marvin plays an ex-trail scout, and Oliver Reed is his half Native American partner who decide to settle accounts with a former partner who cheated them out of stolen money. But the partner has now joined high society!

Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

From legendary director William Wyler comes this bold, epic western, the story of a ship's captain (Gregory Peck) who ventures west to find a hotbed of jealousy, hatred and dangerous rivalries. Burl Ives won a Supporting Actor Oscar® for his role.

This lavish, epic western retells the true story of Wyoming's infamous Johnson County War, a brutal, late 19th century conflict during which wealthy cattlemen, backed by the U.S. government, hired mercenaries to murder 125 immigrant settlers.

Lee Marvin gives a spellbinding performance as Harry Spikes, a wounded outlaw who appears as a romantic figure to three impressionable youths (Gary Grimes, Ron Howard and Charles Martin Smith) and who he enlists them as his bank-robbing partners.
Screen icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this in this sumptuous epic as pioneers who travel the treacherous Oregon trail.

Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!
In this western, a man riding out for revenge against the man who killed his brother instead comes across the killer's own brother…who is blind.
Attempting to affect peace between his men and the Apaches, the commander of a fort unwittingly inspires an Indian massacre.

Screen Legends Kirk Douglas and Walter Matthau co-star in this exciting account of a man who made his name fighting Indians, but who now must use his peacekeeping skills to keep wronged Sioux warriors from exacting vengeance upon a nearby fort.

Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.

En Cali, vecinos del barrio La Independencia tomaron justicia por mano propia tras el robo a Sara Ortega. Cansados de la impunidad, golpearon al ladrón, Jaime Barona López, con antecedentes desde 2002. La comunidad, frustrada por la inseguridad, busca soluciones ante la falta de acción judicial.

Ana, víctima de abuso por su profesor, ve justicia tras años de denuncias. Judith, asesinada en Bogotá, revela una red criminal. Valentina, presunto suicidio, resulta ser homicidio. Angelie, con Diamond Blackfan, recibe un trasplante exitoso. Harvey, policía herido, lucha por su recuperación y justicia.

El 13 de marzo de 2015, en Villa Lozada, La Plata, Huila, cuatro miembros de la familia Ramírez fueron brutalmente asesinados. Aunque inicialmente se sospechó un atraco, la investigación reveló que el crimen fue obra de una banda dedicada al apoderamiento ilegal de terrenos en Ciudad Bolívar, quienes buscaban el millonario botín que la familia guardaba, producto de su negocio de comercialización de café.

En 2010, en Putumayo, Myriam Zamora fue acusada de asesinar a sus dos pequeños hijos e intentar suicidarse. Aunque ella se declaró víctima y refutó las acusaciones de la Fiscalía y de su esposo durante el proceso, no logró presentar pruebas que respaldaran su versión. Sin evidencia que sustentara su inocencia, fue condenada y pasará varios años tras las rejas.

El 17 octubre del 2015, en el corregimiento de Belén, en El Banco Magdalena, dos hombres abusaron y asesinaron a Valeria Peña, una menor de 15 años que logró sobrevivir antes los ataques y dejar un testimonio donde señalaba a José Fernando López como el autor material de su crimen. Sin embargo, un tercer testimonio involucro al hermano de José Fernando y el autor intelectual quien tenía claras intenciones de venganza.

En 2007, María Cecilia Viva Salas desapareció en Buenaventura, generando conmoción en su barrio. Inicialmente se sospechó de pandilleros, pero la investigación reveló que su esposo Harvey era el responsable. Su hija Pilar, testigo silenciada por miedo, finalmente reveló pistas clave. El rastreo del celular llevó a su cuerpo, hallado en su propia casa. Harvey confesó y fue condenado a 18 años, aunque salió libre tras cumplir la mitad de la pena.

Deibis Mildred y Adolfo González formaron una familia y un negocio exitoso de confecciones en Riohacha. En 2008, Adolfo fue asesinado en su casa, un crimen inicialmente sin resolver. Tres años después, las sospechas recayeron sobre Deibis Mildred, señalada de planear el homicidio junto a un amante para cobrar un seguro de vida. Fue condenada a 40 años de cárcel como coautora del asesinato.

En 2008, Nidia Yazmín González, madre soltera de 37 años, fue hallada muerta en el río Gámeza, Boyacá, con signos de brutal violencia. Mantenía una relación secreta con Alirio Castro, un hombre casado, posesivo y celoso. Pruebas clave —su cinturón negro en karate y un historial de maltrato— lo señalaron como responsable. Absuelto en 2009, la fiscalía apeló y en 2011 fue condenado a 33 años de prisión.

Giovanny Padilla, registrador en La Jagua de Ibirico, fue asesinado el 1 de enero de 2018 en Valledupar. Dos jóvenes, Emanuel Castro y Jesús Sánchez, lo torturaron para robarle. Ambos fueron capturados y condenados.
Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.
Mario está demandando a la psíquica del vecindario, Lydia, por $30,000 y la imposición negligente de angustia emocional después de prometer eliminar su maldición ... por una tarifa.

Michelle está demandando a Michael y Nuri por negligencia y pérdida comercial después de que su spa de alta gama se dañó cuando los lechones de Michael y Nuri fueron liberados y se volvieron locos en su negocio.
Alexa está demandando a su novio de un año y medio por cancelar abruptamente el viaje de su vida porque necesitaba traer a su hijo de 7 años.

En la Guajira, Maye rescata niños víctimas de explotación sexual. Carlos Iván vive con el Síndrome de Prader-Willi, mientras que un grupo de jóvenes colombianos construyen con llantas en China, mostrando talento y sostenibilidad.

Elaine Palacio, la única modelo colombiana en portadas de Vogue Italia y ángel de Victoria's Secret, nació en Puerto Boyacá enfrentando racismo y baja autoestima. A los 15 años se fue a Medellín y luego a México, donde fue víctima de explotación laboral, viviendo con solo 40 dólares mientras cargaba una deuda ficticia. Se reinventó, recuperó su carrera y fundó "Negros de Corazón" para impulsar a jóvenes afrocolombianos.

¿Por qué Q, de 21 años, y Alicia, de 55, no tienen sexo más a menudo? Entonces, Jenny se enamoró de un hombre 10 años menor que ella y ha estado encontrando fotos de mujeres desnudas en su teléfono, pero ¿le ha estado engañando?

¿Antonio ha sido infiel a Chasity desde el día de su boda? ¿Mike se está acostando con Lisa, la madre de su esposa? Jackie asegura que Danny es infiel y él asegura que ella lo es... ¡Maury tiene todos los resultados!

A newcomer has an aggressive start to their first battle, with no competitor or house robot left unchallenged. Will they make it all the way to final or be punished for their hubris?

Susan (Hayes) has always been the self-centered oddball in her family who lazily skated through life with their begrudging support until one day she wakes up to realize she's middle-aged with no job, no relationship, and an increasingly estranged family. She finally decides to take charge and turn things around, but never having done anything herself before, the struggle is real (and hilarious) as Susan becomes the woman she always wanted to be, all on her own.
A small group of scientists and soldiers have taken refuge in an underground missile silo where they struggle to control the flesh-eating horror that walks the earth above.

A man finds himself developing a new perspective on life once he finds out it's almost over. Benjamin Kasparian is a paleontologist of Armenian descent who has just split up with his wife Amanda. While trying to readjust to single life, Benjamin visits the doctor and is informed he's suffering from an unusual brain disease called Talbot's Syndrome, and he's not likely to live longer than five weeks. Benjamin is initially philosophical about his fate and decides to enjoy himself as much as he can

As the end of World War II approaches, a group of American soldiers are assigned to watch activity amidst the stark snow-covered landscape of the French-German border and soon discover a battle-weary enemy as reluctant to fight as they are. With common ground established, the German platoon offer to be "captured" and a phony battle is staged to save honor. However, a tragic misunderstanding has devastating consequences in this powerful depiction of war's insanity.

A struggling rock musician finds himself in a living nightmare when he accidentally kills the neighbor from hell.

After the death of his wife, Sheriff Miller is forced into retirement and replaced by Evie Barret, who discovers the town is possessed by demons, and that Stan's wife was the only one keeping them at bay; Stan and Evie must join forces to stay alive.
Stan's daughter, Denise, goes blueberry picking and comes home with a pet goat, which also just happens to be a demon.
Stan, Evie and Denise go speed dating and suddenly find themselves involved with their perfect match; they also find themselves growing weak and rapidly aging.

Evie attempts to rescue Stan's prized possession, his Bobby Orr hockey stick, from the church donation pile, only to find herself transported into the spirit world where she too, is on trial for witchcraft.
A strange crop of flowers starts growing in town, with each bloom bringing a new supernatural horror; Evie attempts to summon Stan's dead wife, Claire, to help her stop them.

Denise gets mixed up with a group of goth kids who come to town hoping to contact a demon; the goth kids succeed in contacting a demon and Denise finds herself possessed by it, creating a tricky situation for Stan.
A mysterious stranger shows up at Stan's door with knowledge of the curse he and Evie are fighting; Willard's Mill residents start getting killed by a giant spider.
A mysterious girl runs out into the street, forcing Evie to swerve into a fatal car accident that she must relive over and over and over again.

Stan begins to solve the mystery of Evie's disappearance and along the way, he meets the descendants of a Wiccan coven known as the Black Hat Society; Stan and the coven discover a disturbing way to bring Evie home.
Stan travels back in time to save Evie, not a moment too soon, as she's in a high stakes situation; Evie's rescue hinges on whether Stan can sacrifice a trusted friend in the modern day.
Evie's ex-husband, Kenny, visits with a new pony and the same old tricks; Stan befriends Kenny until he discovers his unsightly qualities; a mysterious stranger visits Willard's Mill.
Stan gets trapped in a life-or-death bar bet; Evie and Denise watch a dating show finale that may or may not be hypnotizing them into killing each other.

Contestants join a brand-new competition show, but after one vanishes in the Alabama woods, paranoia spreads; the players realize the game isn't the only thing they're fighting for and something sinister may be stalking them from the shadows.

After a discovery at camp, players are rushed to a remote hospital, only to learn it's part of the game; trapped inside, they face grotesque horrors, including a bloated corpse, as Greg Nicotero is revealed as the show's twisted puppet master.

In a junkyard stalked by a ravenous creature, players must cross a narrow beam-rolling a tire as the beast lunges from below; it's a race against fear, balance, and time with the two slow eliminated; for the first time, a prize is revealed.

In a fog-shrouded graveyard, three teams of two are split-one locked in a chained coffin, the other racing to recover scattered remains and complete a ritual; time runs out for one team as they fail to assemble a skeleton before the clock expires.

In a decaying barn, the final four attempt a ritual to contain an ancient evil, but it fails; as the dead rise, the remaining three flee to an old farmhouse for the final challenge, where a competitor is crowned the winner.

After unholy rituals and a siege of the undead, the final episode rips through the fourth wall as Greg Nicotero reveals the twisted art of horror, unveiling creature effects, psychological traps, and buried secrets behind every scream.
Evie buys an antique ring and then starts dreaming of killing people, who turn up dead; Leon kills a dude who may or may not have already been dead.
Denise takes a nanny job for a demon baby who feeds off her affection; Kevin gets beaten up by a baby, which is not a coincidence.

Stan summons a spirit to help him travel back in time to save Claire, and in the process, an evil replica is created who thinks only of murder; real Stan must commit an unthinkable crime to complete his time travel mission.
Stan travels back in time to save Claire, and he succeeds, but dies in the process, forcing Evie to go back and save him; Leon loses his head over a new gal.

Evie is arrested for murder and committed to a psychiatric hospital; Stan attempts to rescue her, but everyone thinks he's a demon; there may be a new way to free the souls cursed by Constable Eccles.
Two eerily familiar paranormal investigators arrive to investigate the Black Hat Society; Stan searches for a bigger evil ally that could help defeat Constable Eccles.
A disgraced birthday entertainer disrupts the peace in Willard's Mill; Evie's ex-husband, Kenny, comes to town; he transforms into a caterpillar monster and terrorizes Willard's Mill.

The cast begins to draw battle lines with one another and choose teams.
The cast must fight independently for their spot in the next challenge; a surprise elimination leaves them all shocked.
The cast is split up into teams for a group challenge, and only one group will emerge victorious.
The mansion and entire cast are beamed to outer space for a challenge.
A murderous hitchhiker terrorizes Willard's Mill; Stan befriends a laid back demon and attempts to find a spell that will free the souls captured by Constable Eccles; Denise and Kevin go on a date.
An antique store owner is murdered by an evil puppet that begins summoning spirits from hell; Stan brews homemade beer with a debilitating side effect.

Stan goes for a prostate exam but must escape when the hospital turns demonic.

Jamie is cooking up four mouthwatering recipes. He kicks things off with a deliciously foolproof aromatic lamb curry that’s put together in no time, followed by his flavor-packed Harissa Squash Salad – upping your salad game with a wicked twist.
Great pork starts with how the animal is raised. Jenn learns about pork production and enjoys a true farm to table dinner.
Loaf cakes share the characteristics of typically being baked in a loaf pan (but not exclusively)- they are moist and rich, but not as dense as a pound cake.

Get tangled in today's episode with Kirsten's creamy semifreddo paired with strawberries, or keep it simple and treat yourself with lovely chocolate lollipops. Kirsten also makes a marble cake that tastes as good as it looks and takes breakfast to the next level with mouthwatering brioche buns.

Host Sarah Sharratt is invited by her local mayor to accompany him on a seasonal pigeon hunt; a tradition that dates back hundreds of years in the region. The hunters inpire Sarah to throw a dinner party featuring stuffed pigeon on roasted fennel and pommes dauphinoise (potato gratin). For dessert Sarah makes an apple tresse with armagnac, another traditional ingredient she sources from a famous local producer.

Get festive today with Kirsten's impressive chocolate berry layer cake, then dive into chocolatey heaven with a gorgeous chocolate flan. The Chocolate Queen also reveals her secret recipe for rum & rasin spread, which pairs perfectly with delicious, golden pain perdu.
On Jamie Oliver’s menu is green tea salmon, coconut rice, and miso greens; plus modern Greek salad, spinach, chickpea, and feta parcels.

Tanya, a Kelowna, BC wedding cake designer, is overwhelmed by the added challenges of running a bakery cafe. It’s losing money and demanding too much of her time.  She needs Steve to show her how to increase her sales by creating new signature products with fresh local ingredients, so she can stop worrying about surviving and spend more time with her young daughter.

Self-taught Felicia has expanded her successful home-based cake business into a full-scale Toronto bakery, but the customers just aren’t coming.  She needs Steve’s help to gain the professional baking skills she didn’t learn online or she risks closing her doors forever!

Diana explores Korean food. Charlie Carrington (chef and owner of Atlas Dining) shows Diana how to ferment your own kimchi at home before cooking up a ‘Beef Bulgogi’, a dish of delicious marinated beef cooked at high heat and topped with quintessential Korean condiments. Diana decides to make a vegetarian version of ‘Bibimbap’.

Los planes de la chef Lia de ampliar su servicio sin ánimo de lucro de reparto de comida a domicilio centrado en el corazón fracasan debido a su insistencia en hacerlo todo ella misma. Pero con la ayuda de su nuevo vecino y reciente padre adoptivo Eli descubrirá que los negocios, al igual que el romance, pueden florecer con un poco de esfuerzo y confianza.

Después de un período de servicio, una enfermera del ejército regresa a la granja de su abuela en un país Amish. Encuentra un romance inesperado con Grace, quien acude a ella para llevar a su mamá al hospital y se ve envuelta en un misterio de asesinato.

Cuando Sarah Goldman, una encantadora y joven maestra de escuela en Chicago, quiere complacer a sus padres, se inventa un novio que cree que será el hombre de los sueños de su madre. Cuando sus padres insisten en conocerlo, Sarah contrata a Bob, un actor, para que se haga pasar por su novio.

Cuando el programa de televisión que protagoniza la actriz Jenna Wilde se cancela repentinamente, la prensa empieza a rodearla. Para escapar del caos, Jenna se retira a una cabaña nevada en las montañas. Inesperadamente, debe compartir este apacible lugar con Chris Dixon, un fotógrafo de naturaleza. Su frialdad mutua empieza a descongelarse cuando Chris ayuda a Jenna a presentarse a las audiciones de otros programas.

Julie Walters, estudiante de doctorado en lingüística, habla casi todos los idiomas imaginables. Es una gran creyente de que los idiomas se aprenden mejor haciendo actividades divertidas. Las cosas se ponen patas arriba para Julie cuando un empleado de un museo se pone en contacto con ella para que le dé clases de francés.

Allí se enfrenta a un trabajo servil que abandonó con entusiasmo antes, y a un hermano con el que no se lleva bien. Aunque anhela irse tan pronto como pueda, descubre que el negocio está teniendo problemas. James enfrenta las tensiones con su hermano y debe decidir qué está dispuesto a sacrificar por los que ama.
